title: 第8章 根本停不下来
slug: 全职法师全本免费-全职法师最新章节列表
content_zh:
操场旁，一片浓密的绿荫，午后的阳光洒落穿过树叶的缝隙化为了一缕缕，像是一个特别的秋后舞台。
对莫凡来说，时间是过得很快很快，觉醒之后这已经过去了有两个月的时间。
这两个月时间莫凡做的只有一件事就是坐在这颗树下——冥修！
第一天第一节课上，班主任薛木生就给所有魔法学生们上了重要的一课：魔法的释放！
魔法的释放一共就只有很简单很简单的三个步骤。
第一，冥修。
第二，把控。
第三，释放！
冥修，顾名思义，就是全神贯注的去思考。
人在闭上眼睛的时候，脑子其实却也在不断的浮想出各种画面。
但如果什么都不想，并且不被干扰的时候，自己脑海是一片空无的！
魔法师觉醒之后，他的这片空无世界里便会出现相应系的星尘。
也就是说，现在只要莫凡闭上眼睛，完全不去浮想任何事情让脑海达到一片如黑色宇宙般空无的时候，雷系星尘和火系星尘就会在这片空无的脑海之中浮现。
雷系星尘为紫色，看上去就像一片紫色的宇宙尘埃悬浮在那里，唯美迷人、绚丽多姿。
雷系星尘内一共有七颗星子，这些星子们在整片小小的星尘里做无规则的运动，就像七个淘气得不听话的小孩，精力充沛的在里面跑来跑去。
对于任何一个已经觉醒了的魔法学生来说，只要能够做到空无中浮现出星尘，并且看到星尘内孩子一样活泼发着光亮的星子，就算是完成了冥修。
可以说，这第一个步骤真的很简单，而这两个月时间所有魔法学生被布置回去的家庭作业就只有这个。
冥修，从吃完晚饭就开始冥修，一直冥修到精疲力尽，便去睡觉。
第二天，白天的课上完后，仍旧冥修，冥修到精疲力尽继续去睡觉……
莫凡并没有偷懒，他这样做了，做了整整两个月，包括周末他也在做着冥修，很多次他都很不明白老师们为什么要给大家布置一项这么简单的任务长达两个月。

“要不，我自己先试试把控？”莫凡觉得自己已经可以很熟练的进入冥修了，于是想要开始下一个步骤。
魔法释放的第二个步骤也很简单很简单。
进入冥修之后，会看到星尘，而星尘内有七个活泼精力充沛无规则跑来跑去的星子。
把控，便是用自己的精神意念去控制这些星子，让它们安静下来，并且乖乖的停在特定的位置，连成一道星轨。
星轨连成，魔法之力将由这道星轨传导到魔法师的身体里，化为真正的魔法，释放出去！
“跑得还真快，让爸爸摸摸。”莫凡开始尝试着与星子做沟通。
用自己的意念去把控住星子，莫凡此时已经锁定了一个撒欢的星子，尝试着让它乖乖听话的停在那里。
“嗖~~~~~~”
那颗星子无比高冷，鸟都没有鸟莫凡，宛如一个碰到怪蜀黍的小萝莉，逃得飞快！
“靠，这么傲娇，算了，换一个试试。”莫凡又开始去与另一颗雷系星子做沟通。
“小乖乖，爸爸在这，快过来，听话……”
“嗖~~~~~”
第二颗星子一副遇到神经病院逃窜犯一样，跑得飞快。
莫凡又试了试其他几颗星子，一个样的，没有一个将莫凡当一回事，有几个甚至感觉到莫凡的意念在让它做什么的时候，它们就跑得更快！
星子在旋转、飞驰的时候，魔法力量是无法传导的。
就好像是一根电线，电能在星尘内部，要想把电能释放出来，就要把星子连成一条线，传递到魔法师身体里……
可惜，这些雷系星子没有一个是听话的，不去碰它们还好，一旦尝试着和它们沟通，它们就跑得飞快，简直跟吃了五百斤炫迈，尼玛根本停不下来！
“这要怎么搞，老子的雷印技能要何年马月才学得会啊？”莫凡一阵蛋疼。
雷霆系初阶技能正是——雷印。
这个技能应该是所有系初阶魔法之中最为实用的技能了，学会了并且熟练掌控，基本上是拥有了出类拔萃的战斗力。

可惜啊，技能不是那么容易学会的。
雷系星子的活跃性相当高，要让他们停下来根本不是一两天能够完成的事情。
“现在我连一个星子都把控不住，要同时把控住七颗星子……路还真不是一般的长。”
果然，读书和学魔法一样，不是一两天就能够搞定的。

content_en:
Next to the playground, there is a dense green shade, and the afternoon sun shines through the gaps in the leaves and turns into wisps, like a special post-autumn stage.
For Mo Fan, time flies very quickly. Two months have passed since his awakening.
In the past two months, the only thing Mo Fan has done is sit under this tree - meditate!
In the first class on the first day, class teacher Xue Musheng taught all the magic students an important lesson: the release of magic!
There are only three very simple steps to release magic.
First, meditate.
Second, control.
Third, release!
Meditation, as the name suggests, means concentrating on thinking.
When people close their eyes, their minds are actually constantly imagining various pictures.
But if you don’t think about anything and are not disturbed, your mind will be empty!
After the magician awakens, stardust of the corresponding system will appear in his empty world.
In other words, as long as Mo Fan closes his eyes and doesn't think about anything at all, making his mind as empty as a black universe, thunder stardust and fire stardust will appear in this empty mind.
Thunder stardust is purple and looks like a piece of purple cosmic dust suspended there, which is beautiful, charming and colorful.
There are a total of seven stars in the thunder stardust. These stars are making irregular movements in the entire small piece of stardust, like seven naughty and disobedient children, running around energetically.
For any awakened magic student, as long as he can make stardust emerge from the void and see the lively and shining stars in the stardust, he has completed his meditation practice.
It can be said that this first step is really simple, and this is the only homework assigned to all magic students in the past two months.
Meditate, start meditating after dinner, meditate until you are exhausted, then go to bed.
The next day, after the daytime classes were over, I continued to meditate until I was exhausted and went to sleep...
Mo Fan was not lazy. He did this for two whole months, including weekends. He was also doing meditation. Many times he didn't understand why the teachers assigned such a simple task to everyone for two months.
"How about I try to control it myself first?" Mo Fan felt that he was already very proficient in meditation, so he wanted to start the next step.
The second step of magic release is also very simple.
After entering meditation, you will see star dust, and inside the star dust there are seven lively and energetic stars running around irregularly.
To control is to use one's own mental thoughts to control these stars, make them quiet, and stop at specific positions to form a star track.
The star track is connected, and the power of magic will be transmitted from this star track to the magician's body, turned into real magic, and released!
"You run really fast, let dad touch him." Mo Fan began to try to communicate with Xingzi.
Using his own thoughts to control Xingzi, Mo Fan had already locked onto a playful Xingzi and tried to make it stay there obediently.
"Whoosh~~~~~~"
That star was so cold and aloof that Mo Fan was like a little loli who encountered a strange creature and ran away as fast as he could!
"Damn, you are so arrogant, forget it, try another one." Mo Fan started to communicate with another thunder star.
"Little darling, daddy is here, come here quickly and be obedient..."
"Whoosh~~~~~"
The second star ran very fast as if he had encountered a fugitive from a mental hospital.
Mo Fan tried several other stars, but none of them took Mo Fan seriously. A few even felt that Mo Fan's mind was telling them to do something, and they ran faster!
When the stars are spinning and flying, the devilMagical power cannot be transmitted.
It's like a wire. The electric energy is inside the stardust. If you want to release the electric energy, you must connect the stardust into a line and transfer it to the magician's body...
It's a pity that none of these thunder stars are obedient. It's okay if you don't touch them. Once you try to communicate with them, they run very fast. It's like eating five hundred pounds of dazzling speed, and you can't stop at all!
"How are we going to do this? How long will it take for me to learn the Thunder Seal skill?" Mo Fan felt a pain in his balls.
The primary skill of the thunder system is - thunder seal.
This skill should be the most practical skill among all elementary magics. If you learn it and master it skillfully, you will basically have outstanding combat effectiveness.
Unfortunately, skills are not so easy to learn.
The activity of thunder star particles is quite high, and stopping them is not something that can be accomplished in a day or two.
"Now I can't even control one star. I have to control seven stars at the same time... the road is really not that long."
Sure enough, reading, like learning magic, cannot be completed in a day or two.
